channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Edges higher above 1.3400, bullish outlook remains intact
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3430 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The UK government leadership transition and growing expectations of further Bank of England (BoE) interest rate hikes underpin the British Pound (GBP) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Retakes $72.00; 23.6% Fibo./200-day EMA holds the key for bulls
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – edges higher during the Asian session on Friday, stalling the previous day's retracement slide from the vicinity of a three-week high.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Sits near weekly top around 1.1450 as bulls flirt with 23.6% Fibo.
item.description: The EUR/USD pair attracts some buyers for the third consecutive day and touches a fresh weekly high, around the 1.1460 area, during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: Gold flat lines above $4,100 as weaker USD clashes with Fed hike bets and Iran risks
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) reverses a modest Asian session dip to the $4,109-$4,108 region on Friday, though it lacks bullish conviction. The US Dollar (USD) selling remains unabated for the third consecutive day in the wake of Wednesday's less hawkish FOMC Minutes and offers some support to the commodity.

item.title: Canadian Dollar strengthens as receding Fed rate hike bets weigh US Dollar
item.description: The USD/CAD pair loses momentum to near 1.4145 during the early European session on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on receding expectations of a rate increase from the US Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: United States Dollar Index falls to three-week low amid signs of US-Iran war de-escalation
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) extends its losing streak for the third trading day on Friday amid signs of de-escalation in the ongoing clash between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: Australian Dollar edges higher to near 0.6950 on RBA hawkish rhetoric
item.description: The AUD/USD pair attracts some buyers to near 0.6950 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) on hawkish rhetoric from the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA).

item.title: New Zealand Dollar extends hawkish RBNZ-inspired rally; hits three-week high vs weaker USD
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gains strong follow-through positive traction for the third straight day and rallies to an over three-week top during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen rallies against weaker USD amid looming intervention risks
item.description: The USD/JPY pair meets with a heavy supply during the Asian session on Friday and weakens below the 162.00 mark as traders remain on high alert amid expectations of a potential government intervention to prop up the Japanese Yen (JPY).

item.title: British Pound gains traction above 1.3400 as markets bet on BoE rate hikes
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gathers strength to around 1.3430 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The British Pound (GBP) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) on the UK government leadership transition and growing expectations of further Bank of England (BoE) interest rate hikes.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7989 vs. 6.8036 previous
item.description: On Friday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7989 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8036 and 6.7931 Reuters estimate.

item.title: WTI consolidates below $72.00 as traders monitor geopolitical developments
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – steadies during the Asian session on Friday, stalling the previous day's downfall amid mixed messaging from the US and Iran.

item.title: Japan’s Katayama: Crucial that government position secures market confidence
item.description: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said on Friday that the government will closely tracking economic indicator and market conditions.

item.title: Euro nudges higher above 1.1400 as traders ramp up their bets on ECB hikes
item.description: The EUR/USD pair posts modest gains around 1.1430 during the early Asian session on Friday, bolstered by a softer US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Japan’s Kiuchi: Government consistently signals policy commitment to fiscal sustainability
item.description: Japan's Economy Minister Minoru Kiuchi said on Friday that the government consistently signals policy commitment to fiscal sustainability. Kiuchi added that there’s no shift in government stance, and monetary policy tools remain the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) decision.

item.title: US official says it remains committed to resolution with Iran, technical discussions ongoing
item.description: A US official signaled that it is still committed to the memorandum of understanding with Iran, even though US President Donald Trump’s declared earlier this week that the framework deal to end the Iran war was “over” after Tehran carried out strikes against vessels in the Strait of Hormuz and again

item.title: Gold recovers above $4,100 as traders assess US-Iran conflict
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) rebounds to around $4,120 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal edges higher as traders weigh a resumption of war in the Middle East.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Bullish amid respected higher-high structure
item.description: The British Pound advances some 0.50% against the Japanese Yen on Thursday, as risk appetite improves after US President Donald Trump said that Iran had reached out and that it wants to make a deal badly. At the time of writing, GBP/JPY trades at 217.76, near year-to-date (YTD) highs.

item.title: Japanese Yen finally lands a punch while Tokyo's silence does the talking
item.description: Dollar-Yen eases about a tenth of a percent on Thursday, changing hands just below 162.50 after fading from the four-decade highs printed earlier in the week.

item.title: British Pound Sterling stages a jailbreak while Westminster arranges a coronation
item.description: Cable adds roughly a tenth of a percent on Thursday, changing hands a whisker above 1.3400 and poking through the 200-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA) for the first time since mid-June.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: Rebounds towards $60, but lower-low structure holds
item.description: Silver price surged by over 2.70% on Thursday, climbing near $60.00 as US Treasury yields retreated and the US Dollar dove by over 0.12%. At the time of writing, the XAG/USD trades at $59.94, after bouncing off daily lows of $57.59.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Fixing guidance fades, path less anchored – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong observes that Renminbi (RMB) appreciation guidance is waning, with CNH-CNY fixing gaps narrowing and daily adjustments moderating. Policymakers appear to be shifting toward RMB stability rather than further appreciation.

item.title: Australian Dollar firms as US Dollar softens
item.description: AUD/USD trades higher near the 0.6940 area on Thursday, as the Australian Dollar (AUD) benefits from a softer US Dollar (USD), even after stronger-than-expected United States (US) jobless claims data showed that the labor market remains stable.

item.title: South Korean Won: Rally versus sustained USD strength – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities’ Macro Research team, led by Howard Du with contributions from Jayati Bharadwaj and Linda Cheng, analyzes the recent Korean Won rally and its impact on USD/KRW.

item.title: Fed unveils Warsh task forces to lead broad review
item.description: The US Federal Reserve (Fed) unveiled on Thursday the members of the task forces announced by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at his first monetary policy meeting.

item.title: Mexican Peso gains as risk appetite improves, weighs on USD
item.description: The Mexican Peso (MXN) registers solid gains of over 0.22% against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday as risk appetite improves after two days of hostilities between the US and Iran ended, despite US President Donald Trump's warning that the deal might be “over.” The USD/MXN pair trades at 17.54 after

item.title: Japanese Yen: Yen eyes BoJ and key resistance zone against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret observe the Japanese Yen trading broadly in line with G10 peers, with near-term focus on the June PPI release and the July 31 Bank of Japan meeting.

item.title: Eurozone: Energy shock keeps pressure on ECB – Nordea
item.description: Jan von Gerich highlights that Eurozone inflation risks remain skewed to the upside due to a persistent energy shock linked to Middle East tensions.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Range bias holds above 1.2890 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes that USD/SGD’s mild downward pressure has eased, with the pair expected to stay range-bound. Intraday, the Dollar is seen trading between 1.2920 and 1.2960, while over the next 1–3 weeks UOB projects a broader 1.2890–1.2990 band.
